_comment: The standard data format every source system delivers or maps onto. It is product-level (the shape of a Temenos Digital migration), not bank-specific: banks adapt through mapping profiles in config/mapping-profiles. The bank data template is generated from this file. Order of record types = order of sheets in the template workbook. Text here is read by bank teams, so keep it in plain language.

CONTRACT.label: Contracts
CONTRACT.description: One row per customer agreement for online banking. It holds one or more customer numbers (CIFs) and their accounts.
CONTRACT.source: Core banking and the current online banking system

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Your unique identifier for this customer agreement; often the primary CIF. It links accounts, users, groups and rules to the contract.

fields.name: serviceDefinitionRef
fields.label: Service Definition
fields.note: The customer's package, for example RETAIL or BUSINESS. Use the values agreed with the migration team.

fields.name: primaryCif
fields.label: Primary CIF
fields.note: The main customer number on the contract. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: legalEntityRef
fields.label: Legal Entity
fields.note: Leave blank if the bank has one legal entity.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.note: Contract contact. If blank, the primary customer's details are used.

fields.name: phoneCountryCode
fields.label: Phone Country Code
fields.note: Digits only, no plus sign.

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.label: Phone Number
fields.note: Digits only.

ACCOUNT.label: Accounts
ACCOUNT.description: One row per account on a contract. Every customer number on a contract needs at least one account.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: CIF
fields.note: The customer number that owns the account. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: accountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.note: Keep leading zeros. List a joint account under each contract that has it; it will be reported for a decision.

fields.name: accountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: currency
fields.label: Currency
fields.note: ISO currency code.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Account Status
fields.note: Your own status value.

USER.label: Users
USER.description: One row per person who signs in to a contract. A user with their own customer number is LINKED. Anyone else, such as a company's staff, is VIRTUAL and needs all personal details.
USER.source: Current online banking system; core banking for customer numbers

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: User Ref
fields.note: Your unique identifier for the user, usually the login ID.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: roleRef
fields.label: Role
fields.note: Use the role values agreed with the migration team.

fields.name: userType
fields.label: User Type
fields.note: If blank: LINKED when User CIF is given, otherwise VIRTUAL.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: User CIF
fields.note: The user's own customer number. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: legacyUserName
fields.label: Legacy User Name
fields.note: The user's current login name, kept after migration.

fields.name: phoneCountryCode
fields.label: Phone Country Code
fields.note: Digits only, no plus sign.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.note: Digits only.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.note: Written as yyyy-MM-dd.

fields.name: taxId
fields.label: Tax ID
fields.note: National ID or tax number.

fields.name: accountIds
fields.label: Account IDs
fields.note: The accounts this user can access, separated by commas. Blank means every account on the contract.

SIGNATORY_GROUP.label: Signatory Groups
SIGNATORY_GROUP.description: Fill this only if the bank has already designed its new approval groups. Otherwise leave it empty and fill the three Approval sheets; the groups are then worked out from them. One row per group member.

fields.name: groupRef
fields.label: Group Ref
fields.note: Your identifier for the group.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must be a business contract on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: groupName
fields.label: Group Name
fields.note: Letters, digits and spaces only. Unique within a contract.

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: Member User Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Users sheet. A user can be in only one group on a contract.

CONTRACT_LIMIT.label: Contract Limits
CONTRACT_LIMIT.description: One row per limit on a contract: one customer number, one action, one limit type.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: CIF
fields.note: A customer number on the contract. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: featureRef
fields.label: Feature
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: actionRef
fields.label: Action
fields.note: Your own code for the transaction type; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: limitTypeRef
fields.label: Limit Type
fields.note: For example per transaction, daily or weekly.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Limit Value
fields.note: Numbers only, no thousands separators or currency symbol.

USER_LIMIT.label: User Limits
USER_LIMIT.description: One row per limit for a user on an account: one action, one limit type.

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: User Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Users sheet.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: CIF
fields.note: The customer number that owns the account. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: accountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.note: Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: featureRef
fields.label: Feature
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: actionRef
fields.label: Action
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: limitGroupRef
fields.label: Limit Group
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: limitTypeRef
fields.label: Limit Type
fields.note: Your own code; send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Limit Value
fields.note: Numbers only, no thousands separators or currency symbol.

SRC_RULE.label: Approval Rules
SRC_RULE.description: Business customers. Your current approval rules exactly as they are today, one row per rule, including users who approve their own transactions. Don't simplify or merge them.

fields.name: ruleRef
fields.label: Rule Ref
fields.note: Your rule ID, unique within a contract.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: Transaction CIF
fields.note: If the rule applies to one customer number only. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: accountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.note: If the rule applies to one account only. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: txnType
fields.label: Transaction Type
fields.note: Your own code. Use * for a rule covering all transaction types. Send the list of codes with the file.

fields.name: currency
fields.label: Currency
fields.note: If the rule applies to one currency only.

fields.name: fromAmount
fields.label: From Amount
fields.note: Numbers only. Use 0 for both amounts if the rule has no amount, such as a statement request.

fields.name: toAmount
fields.label: To Amount
fields.note: Numbers only. Use your system's own value for 'no upper limit', and tell us what it is.

fields.name: makerRef
fields.label: Maker User Ref
fields.note: The user this rule applies to. Fill this or Maker Group Ref if your rules name a maker.

fields.name: makerGroupRef
fields.label: Maker Group Ref
fields.note: The group of makers this rule applies to; list them on Approval Group Members.

fields.name: requiredApprovals
fields.label: Required Approvals
fields.note: How many approvals the rule needs. Use 0 for a self-approving user.

fields.name: selfApprove
fields.label: Self Approve
fields.note: Y if the maker's own transaction is approved automatically.

fields.name: sequential
fields.label: Sequential
fields.note: Y if approvals must happen in a fixed order. Blank means N.

SRC_RULE_CHECKER.label: Approval Checkers
SRC_RULE_CHECKER.description: Who can approve under each rule on Approval Rules. One row per checker slot on a rule. A self-approving rule with no checkers has no rows here.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: ruleRef
fields.label: Rule Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on Approval Rules.

fields.name: position
fields.label: Position
fields.note: 1 for the first checker slot on the rule, 2 for the second, and so on.

fields.name: checkerRef
fields.label: Checker Ref
fields.note: A user ref, or a group ref if Is Group is Y.

fields.name: isGroup
fields.label: Is Group
fields.note: Y if Checker Ref is a group; list its members on Approval Group Members.

SRC_GROUP_MEMBER.label: Approval Group Members
SRC_GROUP_MEMBER.description: Who belongs to each group named on Approval Rules or Approval Checkers. One row per member.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: groupRef
fields.label: Group Ref
fields.note: The group as named in your rules.

fields.name: groupKind
fields.label: Group Kind
fields.note: Whether this is a group of makers or of checkers.

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: Member User Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Users sheet.

PAYEE.label: Payees
PAYEE.description: One row per saved payee or beneficiary of a user. Payee Type decides which columns are needed.

fields.name: payeeRef
fields.label: Payee Ref
fields.note: Your unique identifier for this payee.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Must match a row on the Contracts sheet.

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: Owner User Ref
fields.note: The user who owns this payee. Must match a row on the Users sheet.

fields.name: payeeType
fields.label: Payee Type
fields.note: SAMEBANK, DOMESTIC or INTERNATIONAL for bank accounts; P2P for person-to-person; BILLPAY for bill payments.

fields.name: payeeName
fields.label: Payee Name
fields.note: The beneficiary's or person's name.

fields.name: accountId
fields.label: Account Number
fields.note: The payee's account, or the bill account for BILLPAY. Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: iban
fields.label: IBAN
fields.requiredWhen: Expected for SAMEBANK, DOMESTIC and INTERNATIONAL

fields.name: swiftCode
fields.label: SWIFT Code
fields.requiredWhen: Expected for SAMEBANK, DOMESTIC and INTERNATIONAL

fields.name: bankName
fields.label: Bank Name
fields.requiredWhen: Expected for SAMEBANK, DOMESTIC and INTERNATIONAL

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.note: Digits only.

fields.name: nationalId
fields.label: National ID
fields.note: P2P only.

fields.name: primaryContact
fields.label: Primary Contact
fields.note: P2P only: the phone or email used to send money. Can be blank if both are blank.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.note: BILLPAY only.
